propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed in production code; the Backend port member remote_ref() is not declared on the protocol despite FakeBackend implementing it since J7

instance field must be populated from normalized base URL (scheme dropped, host lowercased, default port dropped, trailing slash dropped, context path retained) injected at backend construction, not resolved at call time
vendor already separates Cloud from DC; instance does not prevent local-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira key alone
RemoteRef is not persisted anywhere, so base URL changes re-label nothing on disk and do not break existing bindings
both concrete backends must implement remote_ref() returning a RemoteRef with instance exactly matching the constructor-injected value, testable with explicit instance argument and no ambient config
